some / any · 易错辨析: some/any both mean 'some'; the choice depends on the sentence type.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:some for affirmatives, any for negatives and questions; Would you like...? uses some。

Affirmatives use some: I have some books|Negatives use any: I don't have any money|Most questions use any: Do you have any questions?|Would you like...? uses some to express an invitation|some can also be used in questions when expecting a yes
